title: Haven't Heard Back (Auto-Close)
style: dark synthwave, deadpan male vocal, robotic female harmony, 88 BPM, vinyl crackle, sardonic, cinematic, sparse drums, modem static, glitch percussion, late-night, abandoned-helpdesk
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Hey there, we're wrapping up this conversation now
Since we haven't heard back from you somehow
March twenty-fourth to March twenty-seven flat
Three days of silence, that's where we're at

[Pre-Chorus]
Sam joined the conversation, Sam left it too
No response means we're auto-closing on you

[Chorus]
Haven't heard back, haven't heard back
Three days quiet, pulling the plug on this track
Haven't heard back, haven't heard back
The AI agent's already turned its back

[Verse 2]
Max subscription set to cancel today
Won't be charged again, that's all Sam can say
Could you share more, could you tell us why
Silence on the line, just an automated goodbye

[Bridge]
If you have a moment we'd appreciate your feedback
To help improve our customer support stack
Rate your conversation: terrible, bad, OK, great, amazing
Your conversation has ended, the screen stops blazing

[Outro]
Drop files or images here, they'll be added
But the thread is dead, the agent's vacated
